description: This file defines the SugarCacheFile class, which manages file-based caching for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. It extends an abstract cache class and handles reading from and writing to cache files, including cache invalidation and serialization.

classes.name: SugarCacheFile
classes.description: Implements file-based caching mechanism for SuiteCRM, handling cache file operations including load, save, and invalidation.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the external cache file backend should be used based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache file name, possibly overriding default based on global configuration.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Serializes and saves the cache data to disk if it has changed when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object for security reasons by throwing an exception.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed; actual writing occurs on destruction.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Loads cache content from the external cache file if it exists and returns the requested key if present.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed for clearing, actual removal is handled elsewhere.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed for reset, actual reset handled on destruction.
